abilitiesData.name: Lifeblood
abilitiesData.description: Uses your skill in Herbalism to absorb energy and nutrients from the earth, instantly healing minor wounds and granting 480 haste rating for 20 sec. Can be used while stealthed or invisible.

abilitiesData.name: Moonkin Form
abilitiesData.description: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Arcane and Nature spell damage by 10%, reducing all damage taken by 15%, and increases spell haste of all party and raid members by 5%. The Moonkin can not cast healing or resurrection spells while shapeshifted.
extra: The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing effects.

abilitiesData.name: Earth and Moon
abilitiesData.description: Your Wrath, Starfire and Wild Mushroom: Detonate spells apply the Earth and Moon effect, which increases spell damage taken by 8% for 15 sec. Also increases your spell damage by 2%.

abilitiesData.name: Mark of the Wild
abilitiesData.description: Increases the friendly target's Strength, Agility, Stamina, and Intellect by 5%, and all magical resistances by 42, for 1 hour.  If target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

abilitiesData.name: Innervate
abilitiesData.description: Causes the target to regenerate 5% of maximum mana over 10 sec.  If cast on self, the caster will regenerate an additional 15% of maximum mana over 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Rebirth
abilitiesData.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 20% health and 20% mana.

abilitiesData.name: Lunar Eclipse
abilitiesData.description: Increases damage done by your arcane spells by 25%. Cancelled when Starfire causes Lunar Energy to reach 0.

abilitiesData.name: Solar Eclipse-boomy
abilitiesData.description: Increases damage done by your nature spells by 25%. Cancelled when Wrath causes Solar Energy to reach 0.

abilitiesData.name: Wild Mushroom
abilitiesData.description: Grow a magical Mushroom with 5 Health at the target location. After 6 sec, the Mushroom will become invisible. When detonated by the Druid, all Mushrooms will explode dealing Nature damage to all nearby enemies within 6 yards. Only 3 Mushrooms can be placed at one time.
extra: Use Wild Mushroom: Detonate to detonate all Mushrooms.

abilitiesData.name: Shooting Star
abilitiesData.description: You have a 4% chance when you deal damage with your Moonfire or Insect Swarm to instantly reset the cooldown of your Starsurge and reduce its cast time by 100%. Lasts 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Insect Swarm
abilitiesData.description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, causing Nature damage over 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Moonfire
abilitiesData.description: Burns the enemy for Arcane damage and then an additional Arcane damage over 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Nature's Grace
abilitiesData.description: You gain 15% spell haste after you cast Moonfire, Regrowth, or Insect Swarm, lasting 15 sec. This effect has a 1 minute cooldown. When you gain Lunar or Solar Eclipse, the cooldown of Nature's Grace is instantly reset.

abilitiesData.name: Sunfire
abilitiesData.description: Burns the enemy for Nature damage and then an additional Nature damage over 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Starsurge
abilitiesData.description: You fuse the power of the moon and sun, launching a devastating blast of energy at the target. Causes Spellstorm damage to the target and generates 15 Lunar or Solar energy, whichever is more beneficial to you.

abilitiesData.name: Wrath-cata
abilitiesData.description: Causes Nature damage to the target.

abilitiesData.name: Starfire
abilitiesData.description: Causes Arcane damage to the target.

abilitiesData.name: Wild Mushroom: Detonate
abilitiesData.description: Detonates all of your Wild Mushrooms, dealing Nature damage to all nearby targets within 6 yards.

abilitiesData.name: Starfall
abilitiesData.description: You summon a flurry of stars from the sky on all targets within 40 yards of the caster that you're in combat with, each dealing Arcane damage. Maximum 20 stars. Lasts 10 sec.
extra: Shapeshifting into an animal form or mounting cancels the effect. Any effect which causes you to lose control of your character will suppress the starfall effect.

abilitiesData.name: Typhoon
abilitiesData.description: You summon a violent Typhoon that does Nature damage to targets in front of the caster within 30 yards, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Hurricane
abilitiesData.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between the attacks of enemies by 67%.  Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilitiesData.name: Perseverance
abilitiesData.description: Reduces all spell damage taken by 6%.

abilitiesData.name: Furor
abilitiesData.description: Grants you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form, allows you to keep up to 100 of your Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form, and increases your maximum mana by 15%.

abilitiesData.name: Furor R2
abilitiesData.description: Grants you a 66% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form, allows you to keep up to 66 of your Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form, and increases your maximum mana by 10%.

abilitiesData.name: Fungal Growth
abilitiesData.description: When your Treants die or your Wild Mushrooms are triggered, you spawn a Fungal Growth at its wake covering the area within 8 yards, slowing all enemy targets by 50%. Lasts 20 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Viciousness
abilitiesData.description: Increases critical strike chance by 1%.

abilitiesData.name: Berserking
abilitiesData.description: Increases your attack and casting speed by 20% for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Beast Slaying
abilitiesData.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Leader of the Pack
abilitiesData.description: While in Cat Form or Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 yards by 5%.  In addition, your melee critical strikes in Cat Form and Bear Form cause you to heal for 5% of your total health and gain 8% of your maximum mana.  This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Mangle (Cat)
abilitiesData.description: Mangle the target and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for until cancelled. Awards 1 combo point.

abilitiesData.name: Faerie Fire (Feral)
abilitiesData.description: Decreases the armor of the target by 4% for 5 min. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible. Stacks up to 3 times. Deals 10 damage and additional threat when used in Bear Form.

abilitiesData.name: Savage Roar
abilitiesData.description: Finishing move that consumes combo points on any nearby target to increase auto attack damage done by 80%. Only useable while in Cat Form. Lasts longer per combo point:
extra: 1 point : 14 seconds
2 points: 19 seconds
3 points: 24 seconds
4 points: 29 seconds
5 points: 34 seconds

abilitiesData.name: Rip
abilitiesData.description: Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your attack power:
extra: 1 point: X damage over 16 sec.
2 points: X damage over 16 sec.
3 points: X damage over 16 sec.
4 points: X damage over 16 sec.
5 points: X damage over 16 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Rake
abilitiesData.description: Rake the target for bleed damage and an additional damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

abilitiesData.name: Ferocious Bite
abilitiesData.description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and consumes up to 35 additional energy to increase damage by up to 100%.  Damage is increased by your attack power.
extra: 1 point: X damage
2 points: X damage
3 points: X damage
4 points X damage
5 points: X damage

abilitiesData.name: Primal Fury
abilitiesData.description: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear Form and your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points  have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.

abilitiesData.name: Feral Charge (Cat)
abilitiesData.description: Causes you to leap behind an enemy, dazing them for 3 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Feral Charge
abilitiesData.description: Causes you to charge an enemy, immobilizing them for 4 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Shred
abilitiesData.description: Shred the target, causing 425% damage plus additonal damage to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point. Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Shred damage.

abilitiesData.name: Ravage
abilitiesData.description: Ravage the target, causing 625% damage plus additonal damage to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilitiesData.name: Stampede
abilitiesData.description: Increases your melee haste by 30% after you use Feral Charge (Bear) for 8 sec, and your next Ravage will temporarily not require stealth or have a positioning requirement for 10 sec after you use Feral Charge (Cat), and cost 100% less energy.

abilitiesData.name: Tiger's Fury
abilitiesData.description: Increases physical damage done by 15% for 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: King of the Jungle
abilitiesData.description: While using your Enrage ability in Bear Form, your damage is increased by 15%, and your Tiger's Fury ability also instantly restores 60 Energy.

abilitiesData.name: Berserk
abilitiesData.description: Your Lacerate periodic damage has a 50% chance to refresh the cooldown of your Mangle (Bear) ability and make it cost no rage.
extra: In addition, when activated this ability causes your Mangle (Bear) ability to hit up to 3 targets and have no cooldown, and reduces the energy cost of all your Cat Form abilities by 50%. Lasts 15 sec. You cannot use Tiger's Fury while Berserk is active.

abilitiesData.name: Blood in the Water
abilitiesData.description: When you Ferocious Bite a target at or below 25% health, you have a 100% chance to instantly refresh the duration of your Rip on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Swipe (Cat)
abilitiesData.description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 711% weapon damage.

abilitiesData.name: Mangle (Bear)
abilitiesData.description: Mangle the target for 50% normal damage plus additional damage and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min.

abilitiesData.name: Infected Wounds
abilitiesData.description: Your Shred, Ravage, Maul, and Mangle attacks cause an Infected Wound in the target. The Infected Wound reduces the movement speed of the target by 50% and the attack speed by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Demoralizing Roar
abilitiesData.description: The Druid roars, reducing the physical damage caused by all enemies within 10 yards by 10% for 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Thrash
abilitiesData.description: Deals damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for damage over 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Swipe (Bear)
abilitiesData.description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting damage. Damage increased by attack power.

abilitiesData.name: Cat Form
abilitiesData.description: Shapeshift into Cat Form, causing agility to increase attack power. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.
extra: The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement slowing effects.

abilitiesData.name: Lacerate
abilitiesData.description: Lacerates the enemy target, dealing damage and making them bleed for additional damage over 15 sec. Damage increased by attack power. This effect stacks up to 3 times on the same target.

abilitiesData.name: Enrage
abilitiesData.description: Generates 20 Rage, and then generates an additional 10 Rage over 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Maul
abilitiesData.description: An attack that instantly deals physical damage. Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Maul damage.

abilitiesData.name: Pulverize
abilitiesData.description: Deals 60% weapon damage plus additional damage for each of your Lacerate applications on the target, and increases your melee critical strike chance by 3% for each Lacerate application consumed for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Barkskin
abilitiesData.description: The Druid's skin becomes as tough as bark. All damage taken is reduced by 20%. While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. This spell is usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared or asleep. Usable in all forms. Lasts 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Survival Instincts
abilitiesData.description: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec. Only usable while in Bear Form or Cat Form.

abilitiesData.name: Frenzied Regeneration

abilitiesData.description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party and raid members within 40 yards, increasing armor. Lasts 5 min.

abilitiesData.name: Flame Shock
abilitiesData.description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing Fire damage immediately and Fire damage over 18 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Lightning Bolt
abilitiesData.description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for Nature damage.

abilitiesData.name: Thunderstorm
abilitiesData.description: You call down a bolt of lightning, energizing you and damaging nearby enemies within 10 yards. Restores 8% mana to you and deals Nature damage to all nearby enemies, reducing their movement speed by 40% for 5 sec and knocking them back 20 yards. This spell is usable while stunned.

abilitiesData.name: Chain Lightning
abilitiesData.description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

abilitiesData.name: Magma Totem
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 1 min that causes Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

abilitiesData.name: Improved Shields
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%, increases the amount of mana gained from your Water Shield orbs by 15%, and increases the amount of healing done by your Earth Shield orbs by 15%.

abilitiesData.name: Improved Shields R1
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%, increases the amount of mana gained from your Water Shield orbs by 5%, and increases the amount of healing done by your Earth Shield orbs by 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Ancestral Swiftness
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 2 sec and increases movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

abilitiesData.name: Elemental Warding
abilitiesData.description: Reduces magical damage taken by 12%.

abilitiesData.name: Unleashed Rage
abilitiesData.description: Increases your expertise by 8, and increases all party and raid members' melee attack power by 20% and ranged attack power by 10% while within 100 yards of the Shaman.

abilitiesData.name: Healing Stream Totem
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals party members within 30 yards every 2 seconds.

abilitiesData.name: Feral Spirit
abilitiesData.description: Summons two Spirit Wolves under the command of the Shaman, lasting 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Stormstrike-cata
abilitiesData.description: Instantly strike an enemy with both weapons, dealing 225% weapon damage and granting you an additional 25% chance to critically strike that enemy with your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lightning Shield, and Earth Shock spells for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Lava Lash
abilitiesData.description: You charge your off-hand weapon with lava, instantly dealing 260% of that weapon's damage to an enemy target. Damage is increased by 40% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Flametongue.

abilitiesData.name: Maelstrom Weapon
abilitiesData.description: When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance (higher than rank 2) to reduce the cast time and mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Hex, or any healing spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Unleash Flame
abilitiesData.description: Unleashes the Flametongue enchantment upon the Shaman's weapon, dealing Fire damage to target enemy and increasing the damage dealt by the Shaman's next Fire spell by 20%.

abilitiesData.name: Unleash Elements
abilitiesData.description: Focuses the elemental force imbued in the Shaman's weaponry, with the concentrated effects depending on the enchantment unleashed.
extra: See individual weapon imbue spell tooltips for details regarding the effects of unleashing each.

abilitiesData.name: Fire Nova-cata
abilitiesData.description: Ignites your Flame Shock spell on any nearby enemies, causing each of them to emit a wave of flames that deals Fire damage to every other enemy within 10 yards.

abilitiesData.name: Ancestral Swiftness
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 2 sec and increases movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

abilitiesData.name: Windfury Weapon
abilitiesData.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of triggering three extra attacks with 46 bonus attack power. Lasts 30 minutes.

abilitiesData.name: Ancestral Healing
abilitiesData.description: Your critical heals reduce physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec, and heals you cast increase allies' maximum health by 10% of the amount healed, up to a maximum of 10% of their health.

abilitiesData.name: Mastery: Deep Healing
abilitiesData.description: Increases the potency of your healing spells by up to 40%, based on the current health level of your target (lower health targets are healed for more). Each point of Mastery increases healing by up to an additional 3.0%.

abilitiesData.name: Focused Insight
abilitiesData.description: After casting any Shock spell, your next heal's mana cost is reduced by 75% of the cost of the Shock spell, and its healing effectiveness is increased by 30%.

abilitiesData.name: Telluric Currents
abilitiesData.description: Your attunement to natural energies causes your Lightning Bolt spell to restore mana equal to 40% of damage dealt.

abilitiesData.name: Earthliving Weapon
abilitiesData.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with earthen life. Increases spell healing by 110 and each heal has a 20% chance to trigger the Earthliving effect on the target, healing an additional 116 over 12 sec. Lasts 30 minutes.

abilitiesData.name: Water Shield
abilitiesData.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water, granting mana per 5 sec. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, mana is restored to the caster. This expends one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

abilitiesData.name: Earth Shield
abilitiesData.description: Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target. This effect can only occur once every few seconds. 9 charges. Lasts 10 min. Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.

abilitiesData.name: Nature's Swiftness V2
abilitiesData.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

abilitiesData.name: Healing Wave
abilitiesData.description: Heals a friendly target.

abilitiesData.name: Chain Heal
abilitiesData.description: Heals the friendly target, then jumps to heal the most injured nearby targets. If cast on a party or raid member, the heal will only jump to other members. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 30%. Heals 4 total targets.

abilitiesData.name: Riptide
abilitiesData.description: Heals a friendly target and additonal healing over 15 sec. Your next Chain Heal cast on that primary target within 15 sec will consume the healing over time effect and increase the amount of the Chain Heal by 25%.

abilitiesData.name: Healing Rain
abilitiesData.description: Calls forth healing rains to blanket the area targeted by the Shaman, restoring health to allies in the area every 2 sec for 10 sec. Healing effectiveness diminishes for each player beyond 6 within the area.

abilitiesData.name: Greater Healing Wave
abilitiesData.description: Heals a friendly target.

abilitiesData.name: Tidal Waves
abilitiesData.description: When you cast Chain Heal or Riptide, you gain the Tidal Waves effect, which reduces the cast time of your Healing Wave and Greater Healing Wave spells by 30% and increases the critical effect chance of your Healing Surge spell by 30%. 2 charges.

abilitiesData.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
abilitiesData.description: Calls upon spiritual guidance, permitting movement while casting non-instant Shaman spells. This spell may be cast while casting other spells. Lasts 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Spirit Link Totem
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Spirit Link Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem reduces damage taken by all party and raid members within 10 yards by 10%. Every 1 sec, the health of all affected players is redistributed, such that each player ends up with the same percentage of their maximum health. Lasts 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Mana Tide Totem
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 10% of the caster's health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec. Party and raid members within 40 yards of the totem gain 200% of the caster's Spirit (excluding short - duration Spirit bonuses).

abilitiesData.name: Summon Felhunter
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

abilitiesData.name: Fel Intelligence
abilitiesData.description: Increases party and raid members' maximum mana and causes them to regenerate mana every 5 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Shadow and Flame
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt and Incinerate spells by 12%, and your Shadow Bolt and Incinerate have a 100% chance to cause the Shadow and Flame effect to the target.
extra: The Shadow and Flame effect causes the target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5% for 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Curse of the Elements
abilitiesData.description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow resistances by 45 and increasing magic damage taken by 8%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Soulstone
abilitiesData.description: Creates a Soulstone. When cast on live targets, the soul of the target is stored and they will be able to resurrect upon death. If cast on a dead target, they are instantly resurrected. Targets resurrect with 30% health and 30% mana.

abilitiesData.name: Demon Soul
abilitiesData.description: You and your summoned demon fuse souls, granting the Warlock a temporary power depending on the demon currently enslaved.
extra: Imp - Critical strike chance of your cast time Destruction spells increased by 30% for 20 sec.
Voidwalker - All threat generated by you transferred to your Voidwalker for 15 sec.
Succubus - Shadow Bolt damage increased by 10% for 20 sec.
Felhunter - Periodic shadow damage increased by 20% for 20 sec.
Felguard - Spell haste increased by 15% and fire and shadow damage done increased by 10% for 20 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Dark Intent
abilitiesData.description: You link yourself with the targeted friendly target, increasing both of your haste by 3%.
extra: When you or the linked target gains a critical periodic damage or healing effect, the other gains increased periodic damage and healing lasting for 7 sec. You gain 3%, while the target gains 1%. Stacks up to 3 times. Dark Intent lasts for 30 min.

abilitiesData.name: Pandemic
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the global cooldown of your Bane and Curse spells by .5 sec.
extra: Your Drain Soul has a 100% chance to refresh the duration of your Unstable Affliction spell when dealing damage on targets below 25% health.

abilitiesData.name: Unstable Affliction
abilitiesData.description: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing damage over 15 sec. In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause damage to the dispeller and silence them for 4 sec. Only one Unstable Affliction or Immolate per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Corruption
abilitiesData.description: Corrupts the target, causing Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Everlasting Affliction
abilitiesData.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction by 15%.
extra: And your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Haunt spells have a 100% chance to reset the duration of your Corruption spell on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Soul Swap
abilitiesData.description: You instantly deal damage, and remove your Shadow damage-over-time effects from the target.
extra: For 20 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the Shadow damage-over-time effects and suffer 1 damage.
You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

abilitiesData.name: Doomguard
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Doomguard to fight beside you for 45 sec.
extra: The Doomguard will assist you by attacking the target which is afflicted by your Bane of Doom or Bane of Agony spell.

abilitiesData.name: Shadow Bolt
abilitiesData.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing Shadow damage.

abilitiesData.name: Haunt
abilitiesData.description: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec. When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage it did to the target.

abilitiesData.name: Bane of Doom
abilitiesData.description: Banes the target with impending doom, causing Shadow damage every 15 sec. When Bane of Doom deals damage, it has a 20% chance to summon a Demon guardian.
extra: Only one target can have Bane of Doom at a time, only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts for 1 min.

abilitiesData.name: Shadowflame
abilitiesData.description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take Shadow damage and an additional Fire damage over 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Drain Soul
abilitiesData.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 5 Shadow damage over 15 sec.
extra: If the target is at or below 1% health, Drain Soul causes double the normal damage.
If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains 3 Soul Shards. Soul Shards are required for Soulburn.

abilitiesData.name: Soulburn
abilitiesData.description: Consumes a Soul Shard, allowing you to use the secondary effects on some of your spells.

abilitiesData.name: Fel Flame
extra: Deals Shadowflame damage to an enemy target, increasing the duration of Immolate or Unstable Affliction by 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Bane of Agony
extra: Banes the target with agony, causing Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Soulburn: Seed of Corruption
abilitiesData.description: Grants the Soulburn empowerment to your Seed of Corruption spell.
extra: Your Seed of Corruption detonation effect will afflict Corruption on all enemy targets. The Soul Shard will be refunded if the detonation is successful.

abilitiesData.name: Seed of Corruption
abilitiesData.description: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing Shadow damage over 18 sec. When the target takes X total damage or dies, the seed will inflict Shadow damage to all enemies within 15 yards of the target. Only one Corruption spell per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Demonic Pact
abilitiesData.description: Increases your spell damage by 2%, and your summoned demon grants the Demonic Pact effect to all nearby friendly party and raid members.
extra: The Demonic Pact effect increases spell power by 10%.

abilitiesData.name: Hand of Gul'dan
abilitiesData.description: Summons a falling meteor down upon the enemy target, dealing Shadowflame damage and erupts an aura of magic within 4 yards, causing all targets within it to have a 10% increased  chance to be critically hit by any Warlock demons. The aura lasts for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Immolate
abilitiesData.description: Burns the enemy for Fire damage and then an additional Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Cremation
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your Hellfire by 30%, and your Hand of Gul'dan has a 100% chance to refresh the duration of your Immolate on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Summon Felguard
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

abilitiesData.name: Soul Harvest
abilitiesData.description: You seek out nearby wandering souls, regenerating 45% health and 3 soul shards over 9 sec. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilitiesData.name: Incinerate
abilitiesData.description: Deals Fire damage to your target and an additional Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

abilitiesData.name: Felstorm
abilitiesData.description: The Felguard recklessly swings its Axe, striking all nearby targets within 8 yards for its weapon damage and continuing to perform the attack every 1 sec for 6 sec. The Felguard cannot perform any other abilities during Felstorm.

abilitiesData.name: Metamorphosis
abilitiesData.description: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec. This form increases your armor by 600%, damage by 20%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%. You gain some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities.

abilitiesData.name: Immolation Aura
abilitiesData.description: Ignites the area surrounding you, causing Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Soul Fire
abilitiesData.description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing Fire damage.

abilitiesData.name: Decimation
abilitiesData.description: When you Shadowbolt, Incinerate or Soul Fire a target that is at or below 25% health, the cast time of your Soul Fire spell is reduced by 40% for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Hellfire
abilitiesData.description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing Fire damage to himself and Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Summon Imp
abilitiesData.description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Pact
abilitiesData.description: Increases party and raid members' Stamina.

abilitiesData.name: Soul Leech
abilitiesData.description: Your Shadowburn, Soul Fire and Chaos Bolt instantly restore 4% of your total health and mana when they deal damage and also grant Replenishment.
extra: Replenishment - Grants up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration equal to 1% of their maximum mana per 10 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Improved Soul Fire
abilitiesData.description: Increases your Fire and Shadow damage done by 8% for 20 sec after you deal damage with Soul Fire.

abilitiesData.name: Empowered Imp
abilitiesData.description: Your Imp's Firebolt has a 4% chance to cause your next Soul Fire spell to be instant cast within 8 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Bane of Havoc
abilitiesData.description: Banes the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the baned target.
extra: Only one target can have Bane of Havoc at a time, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Conflagrate
abilitiesData.description: Instantly deals fire damage equal to 60% of your Immolate's periodic damage on the target

abilitiesData.name: Chaos Bolt
abilitiesData.description: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing Fire damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption effects.

abilitiesData.name: Shadowburn
abilitiesData.description: Instantly blasts the target for Shadowflame damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains 3 Soul Shards. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

abilitiesData.name: Rain of Fire
abilitiesData.description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Frenzy
abilitiesData.description: Your bleed effects cause targets to take an extra 4% physical damage. Applying a bleed effect increases bleed damage taken by the target by 30% for 1 min. In addition, your autoattacks have a 10% chance to generate 20 additional Rage.

abilitiesData.name: Battle Shout
abilitiesData.description: Increases Strength and Agility of all raid and party members within 30 yards, and generates 20 Rage. Lasts 2 min.

abilitiesData.name: Commanding Shout
abilitiesData.description: Generates 20 Rage and increases the Stamina of all party and raid members within 30 yards. Lasts 2 min.

abilitiesData.name: Sunder Armor
abilitiesData.description: Strikes at the defenses of your target, reducing their armor by 4%. Sunder Armor causes a large amount of threat, increased by attack power. Can be applied up to 3 times. Lasts 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Colossus Smash
abilitiesData.description: Smashes a target for 150% weapon damage plus 120 and weakens their defenses, allowing your attacks to entirely bypass 100% of their armor for 6 sec. Bypasses less armor on players.

abilitiesData.name: Deadly Calm
abilitiesData.description: For the next 10 sec, none of your abilities cost rage, but you continue to generate rage. Cannot be used during Inner Rage.

abilitiesData.name: Battle Stance
abilitiesData.description: A balanced combat stance. Increases damage done by 5%. Decreases damage taken by 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Tactical Mastery
abilitiesData.description: You retain up to an additional 50 Rage when you change stances.

abilitiesData.name: Rend
abilitiesData.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for damage over 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Overpower
abilitiesData.description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing 174% weapon damage. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

abilitiesData.name: Shattering Throw
abilitiesData.description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing damage (based on attack power), reducing the armor on the target by 20% for 10 sec or removing any invulnerabilities.

abilitiesData.name: Thunder Clap
abilitiesData.description: Blasts enemies within 8 yards for 15 damage, and increases the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec. Damage increased by attack power.

abilitiesData.name: Taste for Blood
abilitiesData.description: Increases your Overpower critical strike chance by 60%. In addition, whenever your Rend ability causes damage, you have a 100% chance of allowing the use of Overpower for 9 sec. This effect will not occur more than once every 5 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Berserker Stance
abilitiesData.description: An aggressive combat stance. Increases damage done by 10%.

abilitiesData.name: Mortal Strike
abilitiesData.description: A vicious strike that deals 80% weapon damage and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing received for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Lambs to the Slaughter
abilitiesData.description: Your Mortal Strike causes the Slaughter effect, which refreshes the duration of Rend on the target and increases the damage of your Execute, Overpower, Slam and Mortal Strike by 10%. Lasts 15 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

abilitiesData.name: Bloodrage
abilitiesData.description: Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Inner Rage
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Strike and Cleave by 50% for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Recklessness
abilitiesData.description: Grants your special attacks an additional 50% chance to critically hit, but increases all damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Heroic Strike
abilitiesData.description: An attack that instantly deals physical damage. A good attack for moments of excess rage.

abilitiesData.name: Battle Trance
abilitiesData.description: Your Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike and Shield Slam hits have a 15% chance to make your next special attack that costs more than 5 Rage consume no Rage.

abilitiesData.name: Execute
abilitiesData.description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing physical damage and consumes up to 20 additional Rage to deal up to X additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

abilitiesData.name: Slam
abilitiesData.description: Slams the opponent, causing 110% weapon damage.

abilitiesData.name: Sweeping Strikes
abilitiesData.description: Your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Cleave
abilitiesData.description: A sweeping attack that strikes the target and a nearby ally, dealing physical damage.

abilitiesData.name: Blood and Thunder
abilitiesData.description: When you Thunder Clap a target affected by your Rend, you have a 100% chance to affect every target with Rend.

abilitiesData.name: Bladestorm
abilitiesData.description: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, instantly striking all nearby targets for 150% weapon damage and continuing to perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec for 6 sec. While under the effects of Bladestorm, you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless killed or disarmed, but you cannot perform any other abilities.

abilitiesData.name: Whirlwind
abilitiesData.description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack all enemies within 8 yards, causing 84% weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.  If Whirlwind deals damage to 4 or more targets with the main-hand weapon, its cooldown will be reduced by 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Axe Specialization
abilitiesData.description: Expertise with Fist Weapons, Axes, and Two-Handed Axes increased by 3.

abilitiesData.name: Rampage
abilitiesData.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 yds by 5%. In addition, improves your critical strike chance by an additional 2%.

abilitiesData.name: Berserker Rage
abilitiesData.description: Enter a berserker rage, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects, and causing extra Rage generation when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Death Wish
abilitiesData.description: When activated you become Enraged, increasing your physical damage by 20% but increasing all damage taken by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Executioner
abilitiesData.description: Your Execute hits have a 100% chance to improve your melee attack speed by 5% for 9 sec. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

abilitiesData.name: Bloodthirst
abilitiesData.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage. In addition, the next 3 successful melee attacks will restore 0.5% of max health. This effect lasts 8 sec. Damage is based on your attack power.

abilitiesData.name: Raging Blow
abilitiesData.description: A mighty blow that deals 128% weapon damage from both melee weapons. Can only be used while Enraged.

abilitiesData.name: Bloodsurge
abilitiesData.description: Your Bloodthirst hits have a 30% chance of making your next Slam instant, free, and deal 20% more damage for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Single-Minded Fury
abilitiesData.description: When you dual-wield one-handed weapons, you deal 20% additional damage and Slam hits with both weapons.

abilitiesData.name: Titan's Grip
abilitiesData.description: Allows you to equip two-handed axes, maces and swords in one hand.

abilitiesData.name: Devastate
abilitiesData.description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes weapon damage for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 3 times.

abilitiesData.name: Heroic Throw
abilitiesData.description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing damage (based on attack power). This ability causes high threat

abilitiesData.name: Charge
abilitiesData.description: Charges an enemy, inflicting normal damage plus a bonus.

abilitiesData.name: Heroic Leap
abilitiesData.description: Leap through the air towards a targeted location, slamming down with destructive force to deal damage on all enemies within 8 yards.

abilitiesData.name: Shield Block
abilitiesData.description: Increases your chance to block by 25% for 10 sec. In addition, if your total chance to block or avoid an attack exceeds 100%, your chance to critically block is increased by the excess.

abilitiesData.name: Heavy Repercussions
abilitiesData.description: While your Shield Block is active, your Shield Slam hits for an additional 100% damage.

abilitiesData.name: Shield Slam
abilitiesData.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing damage (based on attack power) and dispelling 1 magic effect on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Vigilance
abilitiesData.description: Focus your protective gaze on a party or raid member. Each time they are hit by an attack, your Taunt cooldown is refreshed and you gain Vengeance as if 20% of the damage was done to you.  Lasts 30 min. This effect can only be on one target at a time.

abilitiesData.name: Demoralizing Shout
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the physical damage caused by all enemies within 10 yards by 10% for 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Retaliation
abilitiesData.description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 12 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 20 attacks will cause retaliation.

abilitiesData.name: Sword and Board
abilitiesData.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Devastate by 15%. In addition, when your Devastate or Revenge deal damage, they have a 30% chance of refreshing the cooldown of your Shield Slam and reducing its cost by 100% for 5 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Revenge
abilitiesData.description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for damage. Revenge is only usable after a successful block, dodge, or parry.

abilitiesData.name: Shockwave
abilitiesData.description: Sends a wave of force in front of you, causing damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets within 10 yards in a frontal cone for 4 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Enraged Regeneration
abilitiesData.description: You regenerate 30% of your total health over 10 sec. Can only be used while Enraged, and new Enrage effects may not be gained while active.

abilitiesData.name: Bastion of Defense
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% while in Defensive Stance. In addition, when you block, dodge or parry an attack you have a 20% chance to become Enraged, increasing physical damage done by 10% for 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Last Stand
abilitiesData.description: Temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

abilitiesData.name: Shield Wall
abilitiesData.description: Reduces all damage taken by 40% for 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Deep Wounds
abilitiesData.description: Your critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealing 48% of your melee weapon's average damage over 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Quickness
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the chance that melee and ranged attackers will hit you by 2%.

abilitiesData.name: Regeneration
abilitiesData.description: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. 10% of total Health regeneration may continue during combat.

abilitiesData.name: Abomination's Might
abilitiesData.description: Increases melee attack power by 20% and ranged attack power by 10% of party and raid members within 100 yards. Also increases your total Strength by 2%.

abilitiesData.name: Scarlet Fever
abilitiesData.description: Causes your Blood Plague to afflict enemies with Scarlet Fever, reducing their physical damage dealt by 10% for 21 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Horn of Winter
abilitiesData.description: The Death Knight blows the Horn of Winter, which generates 10 Runic Power and increases total Strength and Agility of all party or raid members within 45 yards. Lasts 2 min.

abilitiesData.name: Raise Ally
abilitiesData.description: Pours dark energy into a dead target, reuniting spirit and body to allow the target to reenter battle with 20% health and 20% mana.

abilitiesData.name: Death Strike
abilitiesData.description: Unleash a powerful strike that heals you for 20% of the damage you have sustained during the preceding 5 sec (minimum of at least 7% of your maximum health), while also dealing 150% weapon damage to an enemy if the attack is successful.

abilitiesData.name: Mastery: Blood Shield
abilitiesData.description: Each time you heal yourslef with Death Stike while in Blood Presence, you gain 50% of the amount healed as a damage absoption shield. Each point of Mastery increases the shiled by an additional 6.25%.

abilitiesData.name: Outbreak
abilitiesData.description: Instantly applies Blood Plague and Frost Fever to the target enemy.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Plague
abilitiesData.description: A disease that deals Shadow damage every 3 sec for 21 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Frost Fever
abilitiesData.description: A disease dealing Frost damage every 3 sec and reducing the target's melee and ranged attack speed by 20% for 21 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Icy Touch
abilitiesData.description: Chills the target for Frost damage and infects them with Frost Fever, a disease that deals periodic damage and reduces melee and ranged attack speed by 20% for 21 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Plague Strike
abilitiesData.description: A vicious strike that deals 100% weapon damage and infects the target with Blood Plague, a disease dealing Shadow damage over time.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Presence
abilitiesData.description: You assume the presence of Blood, increasing Stamina by 8%, armor contribution from cloth, leather, mail and plate items by 55%, and reducing damage taken by 8%. Increases threat generated. Only one Presence may be active at a time, and assuming a new Presence will consume any stored Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Bone Shield-cata
abilitiesData.description: Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones. The shield begins with 6 charges, and each damaging attack consumes a charge. While at least 1 charge remains, you take 20% less damage from all sources and deal 2% more damage with all attacks, spells and abilities. Lasts 5 min.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Tap
abilitiesData.description: Immediately activates a Blood Rune and converts it into a Death Rune for the next 20 sec. Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

abilitiesData.name: Empower Rune Weapon
abilitiesData.description: Empower your rune weapon, immediately activating all your runes and generating 25 Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Raise Dead
abilitiesData.description: Raises a Ghoul to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one Ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.

abilitiesData.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
abilitiesData.description: Summons a second rune weapon that fights on its own for 12 sec, mirroring the Death Knight's attacks. The rune weapon also assists in defense of its master, granting an additional 20% parry chance while active.

abilitiesData.name: Rune Strike
abilitiesData.description: Strike the target for 180% weapon damage. Only usable while in Blood Presence, or for 10 sec after the Death Knight dodges or parries. This attack cannot be dodged, blocked, or parried, and causes a high amount of threat.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Rites
abilitiesData.description: Whenever you hit with Death Strike or Obliterate, the Frost and Unholy Runes will become Death Runes when they activate. Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Strike
abilitiesData.description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 80% weapon damage. Damage is increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Death and Decay
abilitiesData.description: Corrupts the ground targeted by the Death Knight, causing Shadow damage every sec that targets remain in the area for 10 sec. This ability produces a high amount of threat.

abilitiesData.name: Pestilence
abilitiesData.description: Spreads existing Blood Plague and Frost Fever infections from your target to all other enemies within 10 yards. Diseases spread this way deal 50% of normal damage.

abilitiesData.name: Blood Boil
abilitiesData.description: Boils the blood of all enemies within 10 yards, dealing Shadow damage. Deals additional damage to targets infected with Blood Plague or Frost Fever.

abilitiesData.name: Rune Tap
abilitiesData.description: Converts 1 Blood Rune into 10% of your maximum health.

abilitiesData.name: Vampiric Blood
abilitiesData.description: Temporarily grants the Death Knight 15% of maximum health and increases the amount of health received from healing spells and effects by 25% for 10 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

abilitiesData.name: Icebound Fortitude
abilitiesData.description: The Death Knight freezes his blood to become immune to Stun effects and reduce all damage taken by 20% for 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Army of the Dead
abilitiesData.description: Summons an entire legion of Ghouls to fight for the Death Knight. The Ghouls will swarm the area, taunting and fighting anything they can. While channelling Army of the Dead, the Death Knight takes less damage equal to his Dodge plus Parry chance.

abilitiesData.name: Anti-Magic Shell
abilitiesData.description: Surrounds the Death Knight in an Anti-Magic Shell, absorbing 75% of the damage dealt by harmful spells (up to a maximum of 50% of the Death Knight's health) and preventing application of harmful magical effects.  Lasts 5 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Death Pact
abilitiesData.description: Sacrifices an undead minion, healing the Death Knight for 25% of his maximum health. This heal cannot be a critical.

abilitiesData.name: Scent of Blood
abilitiesData.description: You have a 15% chance after dodging, parrying or taking direct damage to gain the Scent of Blood effect, causing your next 3 melee hits to generate 10 Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Virulence
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your diseases by 30%.

abilitiesData.name: Crimson Scourge
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage dealt by your Blood Boil by 40%, and when you land a melee attack on a target that is infected with your Blood Plague, there is a 10% chance that your next Blood Boil will consume no runes.

abilitiesData.name: Brittle Bones
abilitiesData.description: Your Strength is increased by 4% and your Frost Fever chills the bones of its victims, increasing their physical damage taken by 4%.

abilitiesData.name: Improved Icy Talons
abilitiesData.description: Increases the melee and ranged attack speed of all party and raid members within 100 yards by 10%, and your own attack speed by an additional 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Blood of the North
abilitiesData.description: Permanently transforms your Blood Runes into Death Runes. Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost, or Unholy Rune.

abilitiesData.name: Killing Machine
abilitiesData.description: Your autoattacks have a chance to grant a 100% critical strike bonus to your next Obliterate or Frost Strike. Effect occurs more often than Killing Machine (Rank 2).

abilitiesData.name: Rime
abilitiesData.description: Your Obliterate has a 45% chance to cause your next Howling Blast or Icy Touch to consume no runes.

abilitiesData.name: Frost Strike
abilitiesData.description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 130% weapon damage as Frost damage.

abilitiesData.name: Runic Empowerment
abilitiesData.description: When you land a damaging Death Coil, Frost Strike, or Rune Strike, you have a 45% chance to activate a random fully depleted rune.

abilitiesData.name: Unholy Presence
abilitiesData.description: You are infused with unholy fury, increasing attack speed and rune regeneration by 10%, and movement speed by 15%, and reducing the global cooldown on your abilities by 0.5 sec. Only one Presence may be active at a time, and assuming a new Presence will consume any stored Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Pillar of Frost
abilitiesData.description: Calls upon the power of Frost to increase the Death Knight's Strength by 20%. Icy crystals hang heavy upon the Death Knight's body, providing immunity against external movement such as knockbacks. Lasts 20 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Howling Blast
abilitiesData.description: Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing Frost damage to that foe, and Frost damage to all other enemies within 10 yards.

abilitiesData.name: Obliterate
abilitiesData.description: A brutal instant attack that deals 150% weapon damage. Total damage is increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

abilitiesData.name: Ebon Plaguebringer
abilitiesData.description: Your Plague Strike, Icy Touch, Chains of Ice, and Outbreak abilities also infect their target with Ebon Plague, which increases damage taken from your diseases by 30% and all magic damage taken by an additional 8%.

abilitiesData.name: Festering Strike
abilitiesData.description: An instant attack that deals 150% weapon damage and increases the duration of your Blood Plague, Frost Fever, and Chains of Ice effects on the target by up to 6 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Reaping
abilitiesData.description: Whenever you hit with Blood Strike, Pestilence, or Festering Strike, the Runes spent will become Death Runes when they activate. Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

abilitiesData.name: Shadow Infusion
abilitiesData.description: Grants your successful Death Coils a 100% chance to empower your active Ghoul, increasing its damage dealt by 6% for 30 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

abilitiesData.name: Dark Transformation
abilitiesData.description: Consume 5 charges of Shadow Infusion on your Ghoul to transform it into a powerful undead monstrosity for 30 sec. The Ghoul's abilities are empowered and take on new functions while the transformation is active.

abilitiesData.name: Death Coil
abilitiesData.description: Fire a blast of unholy energy, causing Shadow damage to an enemy target or healing damage on a friendly Undead target.

abilitiesData.name: Runic Corruption
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the cost of your Death Coil by 6, and causes your Runic Empowerment ability to no longer refresh a depleted rune, but instead to increase your rune regeneration rate by 100% for 3 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Unholy Frenzy
abilitiesData.description: Incites a friendly party or raid member into a killing frenzy for 30 sec. The target is Enraged, increasing their melee and ranged haste by 20%, but causes them to lose health equal to 2% of their maximum health every 3 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Summon Gargoyle
abilitiesData.description: A Gargoyle flies into the area and bombards the target with Nature damage modified by the Death Knight's attack power. Persists for 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Scourge Strike
abilitiesData.description: An unholy strike that deals 100% of weapon damage as Physical damage. In addition, for each of your diseases on your target, you deal an additional 18% of the Physical damage done as Shadow damage.

abilitiesData.name: Sudden Doom
abilitiesData.description: Your main-hand autoattacks have a chance (higher than rank 2) to make your next Death Coil cost no Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Heart Strike
abilitiesData.description: Instantly strike the target and up to two additional nearby enemies, causing 175% weapon damage on the primary target, with each additional enemy struck taking 25% less damage than the previous target. Damage dealt to each target is increased by an additional 15% for each of your diseases present.

abilitiesData.name: Butchery
abilitiesData.description: Whenever you kill an enemy that grants experience or honor, you generate up to 20 Runic Power. In addition, you generate 2 Runic Power per 5 sec while in combat.

abilitiesData.name: Ignite
abilitiesData.description: Your critical strikes from non-periodic Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Seals of Command
abilitiesData.description: Your Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Truth, and Seal of Justice now also deal 7% weapon damage when triggered. In addition, your Seal of Righteousness now hits all enemy targets within melee range.

abilitiesData.name: Shadow Orb
abilitiesData.description: The priest is surrounded by Shadow Orbs, stacking up to 3 times. When the priest casts Mind Blast or Mind Spike, all Shadow Orbs are consumed, each increasing the spell damage done.

abilitiesData.name: Improved Blood Tap
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Blood Tap ability by 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Anti-Magic Zone
abilitiesData.description: Places a large, stationary Anti-Magic Zone that reduces spell damage done to party or raid members inside it by 75%. The Anti-Magic Zone lasts for 10 sec or until it absorbs spell damage (scales off Attack Power).

abilitiesData.name: Force of Nature
abilitiesData.description: Summons 3 treants to attack enemy targets for 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Shooting Stars
abilitiesData.description: You have a chance when you deal damage with your Moonfire or Insect Swarm to instantly reset the cooldown of your Starsurge and reduce its cast time by 100%. Lasts 12 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Ancient Hysteria
abilitiesData.description: Increases melee, ranged, and spell casting speed by 30% for all party and raid members. Lasts 40 sec.
extra: Allies receiving this effect will become Sated and be unable to benefit from Bloodlust or Time Warp again for 10 min.

abilitiesData.name: Ancient Hysteria (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Increases melee, ranged, and spell casting speed by 30% for all party and raid members. Lasts 40 sec.
extra: Allies receiving this effect will become Sated and be unable to benefit from Bloodlust or Time Warp again for 10 min.

abilitiesData.name: Eternal Glory
abilitiesData.description: Your Word of Glory has a 30% chance not to consume Holy Power.

abilitiesData.name: Pursuit of Justice
abilitiesData.description: You have a 100% chance to gain a charge of Holy Power when struck by a Stun, Fear or Immobilize effect. In addition, increases your movement and mounted movement speed by 15%. This effect does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

abilitiesData.name: Heal
abilitiesData.description: Heal your target.

abilitiesData.name: Instant Poison
abilitiesData.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts Nature damage.

abilitiesData.name: Deadly Poison
abilitiesData.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for Nature damage over 12 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.  Once stacked to 5 times, each application of Deadly Poison also causes the poison on the Rogue's other weapon to apply.

abilitiesData.name: Coup de Grace
abilitiesData.description: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate and Envenom abilities by 20%.

abilitiesData.name: Lethality
abilitiesData.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, Mutilate and Hemorrhage abilities by 30%.

abilitiesData.name: Bandit's Guile
abilitiesData.description: Your Sinister Strike and Revealing Strike abilities have a 100% chance to grant you an evolving insight into an opponent's defenses, increasing damage to that target by up to 30%. Opponents can adapt over time, negating this benefit, and Striking a different opponent will begin the cycle anew.

abilitiesData.name: Terrifying Roar (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: The devilsaur lets out a terrifying roar, increasing the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Roar of Courage (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: The beast lets out a roar of courage, increasing the Strength and Agility of all party and raid members within 100 yards. Lasts for 1 min.

abilitiesData.name: Tear Armor (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Tears at the enemies armor with the raptor's talons, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Lightning Breath (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Breathes lightning, increasing magic damage taken by 8% for 45 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Ravage (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Violently attacks an enemy, causing the enemy target to take 4% increased physical damage for 25 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Gore (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Your boar gores the enemy, causing it to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Qiraji Fortitude (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: Increases party and raid members' Stamina.

abilitiesData.name: Flametongue Totem
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the spell power of all party and raid members within 40 yards by 6%. Lasts 5 min.

abilitiesData.name: Mangle
abilitiesData.description: Mangle the target for 285% normal damage and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min. Awards 1 combo point.

abilitiesData.name: Curse of Tongues
abilitiesData.description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Mind-numbing Poison
abilitiesData.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 50% chance of poisoning the enemy, increasing their casting time by 30% for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Slow
abilitiesData.description: Reduces target's movement speed by 60%, increases the time between ranged attacks by 60% and increases casting time by 30%. Lasts 15 sec. Slow can only affect one target at a time.

abilitiesData.name: Necrotic Strike
abilitiesData.description: A vicious strike that deals 100% weapon damage and absorbs the next healing received by the target. For 10 sec, or until the full amount of healing is absorbed, the target's casting time is increased by 30%.

abilitiesData.name: Curse of Weakness
abilitiesData.description: Target's physical damage done is reduced by 10% for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilitiesData.name: Lichborne
abilitiesData.description: Draw upon unholy energy to become undead for 10 sec. While undead, you are immune to Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilitiesData.name: Earthquake
abilitiesData.description: You cause the earth at the target location to tremble and break, dealing Physical damage every 1 sec to enemies in an 8 yard radius, with a 10% chance of knocking down affected targets. Lasts 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Summon Doomguard
abilitiesData.description: Summons a Doomguard to fight beside you for 45 sec.
extra: The Doomguard will assist you by attacking the target which is afflicted by your Bane of Doom or Bane of Agony spell.

abilitiesData.name: Molten Core
abilitiesData.description: You have a 6% chance to gain the Molten Core effect when your Immolate deals damage. The Molten Core effect empowers your next 3 Incinerate spells cast within 15 sec, increasing damage done by 18% and reducing cast time by 18%.

abilitiesData.name: Summon Infernal
abilitiesData.description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 546 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 45 sec.
extra: The Infernal deals strong area of effect damage, and will be drawn to attack targets afflicted by your Bane of Agony or Bane of Doom spells.

abilitiesData.name: Sudden Death
abilitiesData.description: Your melee hits have a 6% chance of resetting the cooldown on your Colossus Smash, and you keep 10 rage after using Execute.

abilitiesData.name: Enrage-alternate
abilitiesData.description: Your melee hits have a 9% chance to Enrage you, giving you a 10% physical damage bonus for 9 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Rocket Jump
abilitiesData.description: Activates your rocket belt to jump forward. Other effects which slow the rate of falling cannot be used within 10 sec after using this ability.

abilitiesData.name: Darkflight
abilitiesData.description: Activates your true form, increasing current movement speed by an additional 40% for 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Frost Presence
abilitiesData.description: Strengthens you with the presence of Frost, increasing damage by 10% and increasing Runic Power generation by 10%. Only one Presence may be active at a time, and assuming a new Presence will consume any stored Runic Power.

abilitiesData.name: Ice Barrier
abilitiesData.description: Instantly shields you, absorbing damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be delayed by damage.

abilitiesData.name: Soulburn: Soul Fire
abilitiesData.description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing Fire damage.

abilitiesData.name: Shadow Embrace
abilitiesData.description: Your Shadow Bolt and Haunt spells apply the Shadow Embrace effect, increasing all Shadow periodic damage dealt to the target by you by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times.

abilitiesData.name: Healing Surge-cata
abilitiesData.description: Heals a friendly target.

abilitiesData.name: Sprint
abilitiesData.description: Increases your movement speed by 70% for 8 sec. Does not break stealth.

abilitiesData.name: Wound Poison
abilitiesData.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a chance of poisoning the enemy, causing Nature damage and reducing all healing effects used on them by 25% for 15 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Sin and Punishment
abilitiesData.description: When your Vampiric Touch is dispelled, the dispeller and all nearby enemy targets within 6 yards have a 100% chance to be instantly feared in horror for 3 sec.
extra: When your Mind Flay critically hits, the cooldown of your Shadowfiend is reduced by 10 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Furious Howl (Pet)
abilitiesData.description: The wolf lets out a furious howl, increasing the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 5%.

abilitiesData.name: Thorns
abilitiesData.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 20 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Incite
abilitiesData.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike by 15%, and gives your Heroic Strike criticals a 100% chance to cause the next Heroic Strike to also be a critical strike. These guaranteed criticals cannot re-trigger the Incite effect.

abilitiesData.name: Throwdown
abilitiesData.description: Knocks the target to the ground and stuns it for 5 sec.

abilitiesData.name: Drums of War R1
abilitiesData.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Pummel, Demoralizing Shout, Intimidating Shout and Challenging Shout by 50%.

abilitiesData.name: Bear Form
abilitiesData.description:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 120% and Stamina by 20%. Significantly increases threat generation, causes Agility to increase attack power, and also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement slowing effects.

set_bonus.value: Increases the critical strike chance of your Death Coil and Frost Strike abilities by 5%.
Each time you gain a Death Rune or trigger your Killing Machine talent, you also gain 1% increased attack power for 30 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.
Your Horn of Winter ability also grants you 3 runic power every 5 sec for 2 min.
Your Obliterate and Scourge Strike abilities instantly deal 6% additional damage as Fire damage.
Sudden Doom has a 30% chance and Rime has a 60% chance to grant 2 charges when triggered instead of 1.
Runic Empowerment has a 25% chance and Runic Corruption has a 40% chance to also grant 710 mastery rating for 12 sec when activated.
Increases the damage done by your Death Strike ability by 5%.
Increases the duration of your Icebound Fortitude ability by 50%.
Your melee attacks cause Burning Blood on your target, which deals 840 Fire damage every 2 sec for 6 sec and causes your abilities to behave as if you had 2 diseases present on the target.
When your Dancing Rune Weapon expires, you gain 15% additional parry chance for 12 sec.
When an attack drops your health below 35%, one of your Blood Runes will immediately activate and convert into a Death Rune for the next 20 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.
Your Vampiric Blood ability also affects all party and raid members for 50% of the effect it has on you.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Serpent Sting ability by 5%.
Reduces the cast time of your Steady Shot and Cobra Shot by 0.2 sec.
Your Steady Shot and Cobra Shot have a 10% chance to trigger a Flaming Arrow, dealing 80% instant weapon damage as Fire.
You have a 10% chance from your autoshots to make your next shot or Kill Command cost no focus.
Steady Shot and Cobra Shot generate double the amount of focus.
Your Arcane Shot ability has a chance to grant 30% haste to you and your pet for 15 sec.
Increases the critical strike chance of Arcane Missiles, Ice Lance, and Pyroblast by 5%.
Reduces the cast time of Arcane Blast, Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Frostbolt by 10%.
You have a chance to summon a Mirror Image to assist you in battle for 15 sec when you cast Frostbolt, Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, or Arcane Blast.
Your spells have an increased chance to trigger Brain Freeze or Hot Streak. In addition, Arcane Power decreases the cost of your damaging spells by 10% instead of increasing their cost.

Your Arcane Blast has a 100% chance and your Fireball, Pyroblast, Frostfire Bolt, and Frostbolt spells have a 50% chance to grant Stolen Time, increasing your haste rating by 50 for 30 sec and stacking up to 10 times. When Arcane Power, Combustion, or Icy Veins expires, all stacks of Stolen Time are lost.
Each stack of Stolen Time also reduces the cooldown of Arcane Power by 7 sec, Combustion by 5 sec, and Icy Veins by 15 sec.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab, Mutilate, and Sinister Strike abilities by 5%.
Each of your melee autoattacks has a 1% chance to activate Deadly Scheme for 15 sec, increasing the critical strike chance on your next Eviscerate or Envenom by 100%.
Your melee critical strikes deal 6% additional damage as Fire over 4 sec.
Your Tricks of the Trade ability also causes you to gain a 25% increase to one of your combat ratings at random for 30 sec.
After triggering Tricks of the Trade, your abilities cost 20% less energy for 6 sec.
Increases the duration of Shadow Dance by 2 sec, Adrenaline Rush by 3 sec, and Vendetta by 9 sec.
Reduces the cast time of your Chaos Bolt, Hand of Gul'dan, and Haunt spells by 10%.
Periodic damage from your Immolate and Unstable Affliction spells has a 2% chance to cause your 2 next Fel Flame spells to deal 300% increased damage.
Your periodic damage has a chance to summon a Fiery Imp to assist you in battle for 15 sec.
Casting your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire, and Drain Soul spells has a 5% chance to increase all Shadow and Fire damage you deal by 20% for 8 sec.
The duration of your Doomguard and Infernal summons is increased by 30 sec and the cooldown of those spells is reduced by 4 min.
Soulburn grants a 10% increase to your spell power for 10 sec, and Soul Fire cast with Soulburn active now grants a Soul Shard.
Increases the damage done by your Bloodthirst and Mortal Strike abilities by 5%.
Each time you use Overpower or Raging Blow you gain a 1% increase to attack power for 30 sec stacking up to 3 times.
Your Battle Shout and Commanding Shout abilities increase all physical damage you deal by 10% for 12 sec.
Your Mortal Strike and Raging Blow abilities have a 30% chance to trigger a Fiery Attack, dealing 100% instant weapon damage as Fire.
Heroic Strike costs 10 less rage while Inner Rage is active.
Your Bloodthirst has a 6% chance and your Mortal Strike has a 13% chance to apply the Colossus Smash effect on your target for 6 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Shield Slam ability by 5%.
Increases the duration of your Shield Wall ability by 50%.
Your Shield Slam deals 20% additional damage as Fire damage over 4 sec.
When your Shield Block expires, your parry chance is increased by 6% for 10 sec.
Your Revenge ability now also grants a physical absorption shield equal to 20% of the damage done by Revenge to its primary target.
Your Shield Wall ability now grants 50% of its effect to all party and raid members.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by 5%.
Increases the damage done by your Shadowy Apparitions by 30%.
While you are in Shadowform, your Shadowfiend deals 20% additional damage as Fire damage and its cooldown is reduced by 75 sec.
While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target you gain Dark Flames, which increases the damage done by Mind Blast by 15%.
Shadow Word: Death deals an additional 55% damage, and reduces the damage you take from your own Shadow Word: Death when the target fails to die by 95%.
Your Shadowfiend and Shadowy Apparitions have a 100% chance to grant you 3 Shadow Orbs each time they deal damage.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Heal spell by 5%.
When your Penance spell heals a target you gain 540 Spirit for 10 sec, and being in a Chakra state grants you 540 Spirit for the duration of the Chakra.
Casting your Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Prayer of Mending spells cause you to regenerate 2% of your base mana every 5 sec for 15 sec.

You have a chance when you cast a helpful spell to summon a Cauterizing Flame at the target's location. Each sec the Cauterizing Flame will heal an injured party member within 40 yards for 10000. Lasts 5 sec.
After using Power Infusion or Divine Hymn, the mana cost of your healing spells is reduced by 25% for 23 sec.
Your Power Word: Shield has a 10% chance to absorb 100% additional damage and increase the mana granted by Rapture by 100%, and the duration of your Holy Word abilities is increased by 33%.
Increases the damage done by your Templar's Verdict ability by 10%.
Your Inquisition ability's duration is calculated as if you had one additional Holy Power.
Your Crusader Strike deals 15% additional damage as Fire damage over 4 sec.
Increases the duration of your Zealotry ability by 15 sec.
Your Judgement ability now also generates 1 Holy Power.
While Zealotry is active your abilities deal 18% more damage.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Light spell by 5%.
Grants 540 Spirit for 6 sec after you cast Holy Shock.

statPrios.general: *{"wowClass": "Balance Druids"}* bring 5% Spell Haste with *{"skill": "Moonkin Form"}* as well as Magic Damage taken with *{"skill": "Earth and Moon"}*. All *{"wowClass": "Druids"}* also bring an important Base Stat buff with *{"skill": "Mark of the Wild"}*, as well as incredible raid utility with *{"skill": "Innervate"}* and *{"skill": "Rebirth"}*.
statPrios.intro: *{"wowClass": "Balance Druids"}* still have their *{"wowClass": "Solar Eclipse"}* and *{"wowClass": "Lunar Eclipse"}* from Wrath of the Lich King, but it is no longer as heavily RNG based. You now have an Eclipse Bar that moves left or right depending on what spells are used, so you have control over entering and leaving *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}* and *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*. *{"wowClass": "Balance Druids"}* shine in AoE situations thanks to their new spell *{"skill": "Wild Mushroom"}*, but still do respectable single target DPS. Your goal is to maintain your dots and maximize your damage during your *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}* and *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*, as well as minimizing the time outside of them.
opener: Pre-cast *{"skill": "Starsurge"}*. If you get a *{"skill": "Shooting Stars"}* proc afterwards, save it until you first enter *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Force of Nature"}* before *{"skill": "Bloodlust"}* is used.
Refresh *{"skill": "Insect Swarm"}* and *{"skill": "Sunfire"}* on their last tick or after they expire.
Cast *{"skill": "Wrath-cata"}* and *{"skill": "Starsurge"}* until you enter *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*.
single: Cast *{"skill": "Force of Nature"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Starfall"}*. You can delay briefly to use at the start of a *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*.
Maintain *{"skill": "Insect Swarm"}* and *{"skill": "Moonfire"}*. Re-apply on their last tick or after they expire. You can delay briefly to use at the start of an eclipse.
Cast *{"skill": "Starsurge"}*. This will be an instant cast with *{"skill": "Shooting Stars"}* procs. You can delay briefly to use at the start of an Eclipse.
Cast *{"skill": "Wrath-cata"}* during *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}* and cast *{"skill": "Starfire"}* during *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Wrath-cata"}* after leaving *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}* and cast *{"skill": "Starfire"}* after leaving a *{"skill": "Lunar Eclipse"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Wild Mushroom"}* while moving if less than 3 are active. Cast *{"skill": "Wild Mushroom: Detonate"}* during the next *{"skill": "Solar Eclipse-boomy"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Moonfire"}* while moving.
aoe: Cast *{"skill": "Wild Mushroom"}* 3 times and cast *{"skill": "Wild Mushroom: Detonate"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Insect Swarm"}* and *{"skill": "Moonfire"}* on targets that will live for at least a few seconds.
Cast *{"skill": "Thorns"}* on a tank with multiple mobs on them.
