statPrios.intro: *{"wowClass": "Restoration Druids"}* excel at raid healing thanks to *{"skill": "Rejuvenation"}*, *{"skill": "Wild Growth"}* and their new talent *{"skill": "Efflorescence"}*. It will be crucial to maintain *{"skill": "Mastery: Harmony"}* to buff all of your HoTs, so you will need to cast a direct heal every 10 seconds which adds a bit of flavor to spell usage.
single: Maintain *{"skill": "Mastery: Harmony"}*.

Maintain 3 stacks of *{"skill": "Lifebloom"}* on the Tank(s). Keeping up *{"skill": "Lifebloom"}* the entire fight is very important because of the talents *{"skill": "Revitalize"}* and *{"skill": "Malfurion's Gift"}*.
*{"skill": "Healing Touch"}*, *{"skill": "Regrowth"}*, and *{"skill": "Nourish"}* can be used to refresh *{"skill": "Lifebloom"}* thanks to *{"skill": "Empowered Touch"}*.
Maintain *{"skill": "Rejuvenation"}* on the Tank(s).
Cast *{"skill": "Swiftmend"}* for a burst heal, or on players that are close to each other because of *{"skill": "Efflorescence"}* for AoE healing.
Cast *{"skill": "Wild Growth"}* for AoE healing.
Maintain *{"skill": "Rejuvenation"}* on the raid for AoE healing.

Cast *{"skill": "Nourish"}* or *{"skill": "Healing Touch"}* as a filler depending on how much damage the player is taking. Casting *{"skill": "Healing Touch"}* will reduce *{"skill": "Nature's Swiftness"}* cooldown thanks to *{"consume": "Glyph of Healing Touch"}*.
Cast *{"skill": "Healing Touch"}* combined with *{"skill": "Nature's Swiftness"}* for a huge emergency heal.

Cast *{"skill": "Regrowth"}* for emergency heals. *{"skill": "Regrowth"}* has a high critical strike chance thanks to *{"skill": "Nature's Bounty"}*. Try to use these with your *{"skill": "Omen of Clarity"}* procs.

*{"skill": "Regrowth"}* is your only heal that procs *{"skill": "Nature's Grace"}*, so you will want to cast this at least once every minute, or you can cast *{"skill": "Moonfire"}* for better mana efficiency instead.

Managing these buffs and making sure you aren't wasting them will be critical for optimal DPS. *{"wowClass": "Frost Mages"}* also have an incredible burst window thanks to *{"skill": "Cold Snap"}*, allowing them to use *{"skill": "Icy Veins"}*, *{"skill": "Deep Freeze"}*, and *{"skill": "Frostfire Orb"}* twice each in quick succession.

statPrios.intro: *{"wowClass": "Subtlety Rogues"}* have a rather complicated rotation that involes maintaining many important buffs and debuffs, as well as a handful of cooldowns that require proper usage to maximize your DPS. One of the things that makes this tricky is the talent *{"skill": "Honor Among Thieves"}*, which will roughly give you 1 *{"wowBoss": "Combo Point"}* every 2 seconds. This is something you really need to keep an eye out for because even during times when you are pooling Energy, you will still be generating *{"wowBoss": "Combo Points"}* passively. During fights, you will often be sitting at 3 or 4 *{"wowBoss": "Combo Points"}* and letting *{"skill": "Honor Among Thieves"}* fill in the remaining 2 while you pool Energy. Another huge thing *{"wowClass": "Subtlety Rogues"}* needs to manage is *{"skill": "Find Weakness"}*, which only gets applied when you use *{"skill": "Ambush"}*. statPrios.general: *{"wowClass": "Arms Warriors"}* bring increased Bleed Damage and 4% Physical Damage taken with *{"wowClass": "Blood Frenzy"}* to raids. All *{"wowClass": "Warriors"}* also bring a Strength and Agility buff with *{"skill": "Battle Shout"}*, Stamina buff with *{"skill": "Commanding Shout"}*, and Armor Reduction with *{"skill": "Sunder Armor"}*.
statPrios.intro: *{"wowClass": "Arms Warriors"}* have a simple priority system, but as with any class that uses Rage or Energy, managing your resources properly will be critical to perform well. Making sure you make the most out of your *{"skill": "Colossus Smash"}* windows, and proper usage of *{"skill": "Inner Rage"}* and *{"skill": "Deadly Calm"}* will make a huge impact on your DPS. Another complexity of the *{"wowClass": "Arms Warriors"}* rotation is *{"wowBoss": "Stance Dancing"}*. Performed correctly, *{"wowBoss": "Stance Dancing"}* will result in a small DPS increase, but if done incorrectly, it will result in a DPS loss compared to just staying in *{"skill": "Battle Stance"}* 100% of the time. The talent *{"skill": "Tactical Mastery"}* allows for an additional 50 Rage to be retained when switching stances, which is what allows this technique to be possible. The abilities you need to be in *{"skill": "Battle Stance"}* for are *{"skill": "Rend"}* and *{"skill": "Overpower"}*.  In most single target scenarios, you will only be using 1 *{"skill": "Rend"}*, so the main problem here is *{"skill": "Overpower"}*. Like we mention in the rotation section, *{"skill": "Overpower"}* is only used when *{"skill": "Taste for Blood"}* procs, which can only occur once every 5 seconds so you dont have to use it immediately once it procs. To maximize your time in *{"skill": "Berserker Stance"}*, you should wait to until the end of the 5 second window, switch to *{"skill": "Battle Stance"}*, use *{"skill": "Overpower"}*, *{"skill": "Taste for Blood"}* will proc again right after, use *{"skill": "Overpower"}* a second time, and then switch back to *{"skill": "Berserker Stance"}*. You will be in *{"skill": "Berserker Stance"}* for about 10 seconds, since the next *{"skill": "Taste for Blood"}* proc won't happen for 5 seconds, and you won't use that proc for about 4 seconds. It is recommended to make a macro for each of your skills with it's corresponding stance.
